title: Strangler-fig migration playbook — migrate existing product microservices onto the greenfield cloud substrate, in parallel, trunk-always-green
purpose: Defines the per-service strangler-fig migration pattern, the parallel worktree-lane model, the per-migration Definition of Done, and the cutover/rollback criteria for moving existing FD-001 product microservices (enterprise/workflow/backbone) onto the greenfield cloud-* substrate behind contracts. The substrate itself is greenfield-built; this playbook governs the product-microservice migration. Honest non-claim: target playbook spec; no migration is executed here.

steps: 1. seam: identify the service's public contract (OpenAPI 3.2.0 / proto3 / AsyncAPI 3.1.0) from the api-contract-ssot; freeze it as the migration boundary (ZERO GraphQL per ADR-0565)
2. build ideal: implement the ideal target service (vertical-slice nesting microservices/<ms>/crates, ADR-0357) behind the SAME contract; Bazel build graph; Cedar-gated; OTel-instrumented
3. facade: route through the Workflow/Ontology adapter layer (no direct cross-service calls); old and new both registered behind the contract facade
4. shadow/canary: dual-run; one-cell canary + PRR (QK-04); compare old-vs-new on the contract
5. cutover: shift traffic to the ideal service ONLY when cutover criteria are green
6. retire: decommission the old service; remove the facade; record audit-chain retirement event

parallel_lane_model.lane: one git worktree lane per microservice (separate Bazel target set + build dir); ~21+ logical lanes (parallel-lane-scoping.md); concurrency bounded by the CI farm (Karpenter-elastic Jenkins agents), not a single host
parallel_lane_model.fan_in: merge-queue speculative+batch (ADR-0111); a single serial whole-workspace verify at fan-in; Jenkins required-status gates
parallel_lane_model.affected_targets: Bazel rdeps selects only the changed lane's targets for presubmit (Google TAP model)

definition_of_done_per_migration: contract parity: ideal service passes the frozen contract's conformance + drift gate (api-contract-ssot-drift)
tests: domain + integration + e2e green; cargo/bazel test for the lane
SLO: ideal service meets per-manifest SLO targets in canary (ADR-0340)
security: Cedar default-deny + cosign + 0 critical CVE + audit-chain (QK-06, security_exit)
evidence: multispectrum evidence + audit-chain coverage (vcs-admission gate)
honest: old retired only after new is green; no fake-green
cutover_criteria: quality kits applicable to the service green
rollback: contract facade routes back to the old service; ArgoCD progressive-delivery auto-rollback on metric breach (ADR-0349); merge-queue projected-state revert (ADR-0111).
batch_sequencing: contracts stabilize (P-TARGET) before parallel implementation; substrate greenfield (P-TOOLCHAIN/cloud-* live) before product-microservice strangler; per-service lanes batch by dependency order; no lane starts until its upstream contracts are frozen.
non_claims: Target playbook spec only; no service is migrated, no facade/canary/cutover is executed, no measured evidence is produced.
No production/migration-completion claim; per-service green status stays blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
